summary: Per-frame AI tick for a single vehicle. Entry guard on AIEnableFlag (this+0x32C8 > 1 rejects the whole tick). Two top-level paths: (a) pre-race/formation init when the base-object AI enable is 1 and this+0x45F4 byte is clear, which handles session-phase changes, ring-buffer reset, pit-schedule seeding, the countdown/launch light ramp, and commits throttle/brake outputs before returning; (b) the normal racing tick which computes heading sin/cos from yaw, runs a driveability gate, lap-push timed dispatch, AIAbility refresh, pit entry/exit state transitions, and a driverStatus state machine (0-7) that dispatches steering/racing-line/gearshift logic. Both paths end by writing control outputs into the input fields this+0x3580/0x3584/0x357C.

When global session phase dword_7C56A8 is 5 or 1, clear session-cleanup flags via SessionCleanupFlagClear, then store the current phase into this+0x444C.

Roll-off throttle mapping after the launch ramp: scale (this+0x399C - this+0x39A0) by an interpolation factor into this+0x4434 + 0.5, clamped to 0..1; clamp writes 1.0 into this+0x4438 and 0 into this+0x442C.

Racing tick heading: compute -sin(yaw) and -cos(yaw) from this+0x34F0 (RenderX/yaw) into this+0x448C and this+0x4494 respectively (racing-line direction vectors).

Timed lap-push dispatch: when this+0x413C (timer) elapses, reset it to 2139095039; call AIStateFlagSetter(1) when global dword_7C56A8 == 8, otherwise call AIPushLap(this).
